notes: «وَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ» : the one written to is only a pronoun, so the Imam is taken from prev1 («إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ», supplies: speaker), as inherited, last link.

The writer of this report is not named in its text (the subject of «كَتَبَ» is implicit; prev1 names Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar for its own report only): no named asker is written and none is completed.
